Before you visit

How do I request an appointment?

Use “Request an appointment” to prepare an enquiry on WhatsApp, or call +91 73737 31757. An appointment is confirmed only after the hospital responds.

Is the hospital open around the clock?

The hospital’s existing website lists 24/7 availability. Specialist consultation times may vary; please call before your visit.

Where is Goodsam Medical Centre?

Manalar Dam Road, Chinnamanur, Tamil Nadu, India. Use the directions link to plan your route.
